verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at exa.ai/llms.txt and per-page .md docs that point agents to a documentation index at /docs/llms.txt. The docs also publish llms-full.txt with agent-directed guidance, such as preferring the official SDKs and using the hosted MCP endpoint. Exa additionally ships installable agent skills that teach coding agents to use its APIs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs in practice.
